page.overview:
Who is Mitsumeruko?

Mitsumeruko (みつめる子? lit. "A staring child") is the character from the 13th and final Street Fighter Laboratory corner. A scary person rumored to be a murderer that often carries large scissors. Category:Characters Category:Concept Characters
